title: Anthony V NDE 9963
content: I was shot in the head with a .30 caliber rifle round. The bullet hit a piece of metal next to me before hitting me in the face with many fragments. I know I was knocked back from the table I was sitting at. I was also knocked out. I remember seeing myself from above my body. I watched a bunch of people kneeling around me who were trying to stop the bleeding. I didn't know what happened. I remember thinking, 'Am I dead? Did I just get killed? What happened?' The weird thing is that I saw everything in black and white. There was no pain. I was just confused about being killed and what had happened. I was worried about my wife and kid. Soon after that, I was in my body looking up at the sky. People were putting towels all over my face to stop the bleeding. At the hospital, they found around 50 metal fragments in my face and skull. The metal worked out of my body over the years. I was fine after a few weeks. I have never really talked about it. out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Confusion; sadness; calmness; no pain; vision described as black and white; worried about wife and kid.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Shot in the head with a .30 caliber rifle round; bullet fragmented after hitting metal and struck face/head.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Visual perception during OBE described as black and white; no tunnel, light, beings, or other world.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE occurred; then he was back in his body looking up at the sky; no tunnel/arrival/boundary stages reported.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Perception during the out-of-body viewing was described as black and white.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Am I dead? Did I just get killed? What happened?”; “The weird thing is that I saw everything in black and white.”; “Not sure, but I was somewhere else.”; “I remember it like it was yesterday.”
